מזהה את הרשומה שמתעדכנת (מפתח רשומה "Gen_customercareId" ברכיב "Close Transfer Out")

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: SQL alias ft.gen_valuedate, ft = Gen_ftCurrentYear joined on ac.gen_fundnumber = ft.gen_fundnumber (financial transactions of the account course's fund, gen_transgrouptype = 2, Gen_EntryDate > request CreatedOn); minimum taken by Aggregate (SQL DTSX 2124, 2132, 2135-2136; Aggregate DTSX 133)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: Gen_isfulltransfer of the request: 'Is full transfer out' (Gen_isfulltransfer == TRUE) chooses the gate - full: transferCount > 0; not full: actualTransactionAmount == expectedTransactionAmount (Is full transfer out DTSX 2094; SQL DTSX 2121)
הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: transferCount = count(ft.Gen_ftCurrentYearId): full transfers pass only when > 0 (always >= 1 because ft is inner-joined) (Check number of transactions DTSX 164; SQL DTSX 2127)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: actualTransactionAmount = sum(ISNULL(ft.gen_transtotalamount,0)): not-full transfers pass only when non-NULL and equal to expectedTransactionAmount (Compare sums DTSX 1289; SQL DTSX 2125)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: expectedTransactionAmount = sum(ISNULL(ac.gen_transactionamount,0)) over the joined rows: not-full transfers pass only when non-NULL and equal to actualTransactionAmount (Compare sums DTSX 1289; SQL DTSX 2126)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: MIN(ft.gen_valuedate) per Aggregate group, compared with the delivery date (SQL DTSX 2124; Aggregate DTSX 133)

targets.mechanism: SDK (CRM.Proxy ExecuteMultipleExtension, RequestType.Update, batches of 1000 + final flush at EndOfRowset)
targets.recordKey: customerCareEntity["gen_customercareid"] = Row.GencustomercareId (main.cs:72) - the primary-key attribute is put in the attribute collection (entity.Id is not set); the record is the open transfer-out request Tout.Gen_customercareId (Gen_customercare with Gen_currentstate = 1, SQL DTSX 2120, 2137), grouped by 'Aggregate' (GROUP BY Gen_customercareId, Gen_deliverydate, gen_appendixghissuingdate)
targets.writeCondition: Data flow runs after 'Create ETL Process record' (Success). Source SQL (DTSX 2119-2145, conn [psql] = psql/altshuler_mscrm): Gen_customercare Tout with Gen_currentstate = 1, joined to its gen_accountcourses (ac.gen_customercare), to Gen_ftCurrentYear rows of the same fund (ac.gen_fundnumber = ft.gen_fundnumber) whose transaction type has gen_transgrouptype = 2 and whose Gen_EntryDate > Tout.CreatedOn; grouped per (customer care, isfulltransfer, deliverydate, account course, ft.gen_valuedate, ft.gen_appendixghissuingdate). Routing: 'Is full transfer out' (Gen_isfulltransfer == TRUE, DTSX 2094) -> IsFull -> 'Check number of transactions' Has Transactions (transferCount > 0, DTSX 164); else Not full -> 'Compare sums' Sums Are Equal (!ISNULL(actual) && !ISNULL(expected) && actualTransactionAmount == expectedTransactionAmount, DTSX 1289). Both pass via Union All to 'Aggregate' (DTSX 88), which emits one row per (Gen_customercareId, Gen_deliverydate, gen_appendixghissuingdate) with MIN(gen_valuedate). Every row reaching the script is added to the update batch (no in-script filter). A NOT-full transfer is closed as soon as ONE (account course, value date, appendix date) group has equal sums - other account courses of the same request are not required to match.
targets.expression: customerCareEntity["gen_fundreleasedate"] = Row.genvaluedate.ToLocalTime() (code comment: 'min entry date'). Row.genvaluedate = MIN(ft.gen_valuedate) per Aggregate group (AggregationType 6 = Minimum, DTSX 133) over the Gen_ftCurrentYear rows that passed the splits. ToLocalTime() treats the (Unspecified-kind) DB value as UTC and converts it to the SSIS server's local time before sending.

targets.expression: customerCareEntity["gen_deliverydelay"] = IsDeliveryDelay(Row.Gendeliverydate, Row.genvaluedate) (bool): days = DateAndTime.DateDiff(DateInterval.Day, deliveryDate, entryDate); return days > 0. deliveryDate = Tout.Gen_deliverydate (the request's delivery date, Aggregate GROUP BY key); entryDate parameter = MIN(ft.gen_valuedate) (not an entry date despite the name). True when the earliest value date is later than the delivery date by at least one day per VB DateDiff(Day) semantics; compared on the raw DB values (no ToLocalTime here).

notes.note: Scope: the lineage lists 3 script write components. Only 'Close Transfer Out\Close Transfer Out' is business logic (gen_customercare update: 5 attributes + the primary-key attribute gen_customercareid used as record identifier). 'Close Transfer Out\ETL Warning' (Create gen_etlprocesswarning) and 'End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish' (Update gen_etlprocess) are ETL plumbing and not mapped; their open script outputs (Close Transfer Out.CastingError/Error.Description, Get gen_etlprocessid.gen_etlprocessid) are intentionally left unresolved. Control-flow 'Create ETL Process record' is plumbing.

Record identification: the code sets customerCareEntity["gen_customercareid"] (main.cs:72) and never entity.Id. That the CRM Update resolves the record from the primary-key attribute is standard CRM SDK behaviour, but ExecuteMultipleExtension (CRM.Proxy / CRM2015.Proxy.dll, not supplied) could also handle it - external_unknown.

Multiple updates per request: 'Aggregate' groups by Gen_customercareId + Gen_deliverydate + gen_appendixghissuingdate (DTSX 117, 125, 141). A request whose matching transactions carry different gen_appendixghissuingdate values (incl. NULL) yields several rows -> several Update requests for the same gen_customercare, each with its own MIN(gen_valuedate), appendix date and delay flag; which one is applied last is not determined by the package.

expectedTransactionAmount = sum(ISNULL(ac.gen_transactionamount,0)) is summed over the joined ft rows of the SQL group (SQL DTSX 2126), i.e. the account-course amount multiplied by the number of transactions in that (account course, value date, appendix date) group; actualTransactionAmount sums those transactions' gen_transtotalamount. 'Sums Are Equal' therefore compares N x expected with the total of N transactions. Reported as observed SQL arithmetic; business intent not verified.

'Check number of transactions' (transferCount > 0) can never reject a row: count(ft.Gen_ftCurrentYearId) is over an inner join to Gen_ftCurrentYear, so every group has at least one ft row (SQL DTSX 2127, 2133). Full transfers are closed whenever at least one qualifying transaction exists.

Batch failure handling: ExcecuteBulk() runs inside the per-row try (main.cs:87-88); if it throws, only the current row goes to CastingError, myEntities.Clear() (main.cs:125) is skipped, the list then exceeds 1000 and the '== 1000' flush never fires again; everything left is sent in one request at EndOfRowset (main.cs:134-137) outside any try. ExecuteMultiple faults go to the Error output (main.cs:113-117) -> ETL Warning. No Fault -> the row is considered done; output 'Output 0' (sync) has no path.

Time handling: gen_fundreleasedate and gen_appendixghissuingdate are sent as value.ToLocalTime() (SSIS server time zone); gen_deliverydelay compares the raw DB values. Whether the source views return UTC (CRM non-filtered views) is not provable from the package; the net effect on the stored value depends on the CRM attribute behaviour (external_unknown).
